questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Higher order (>3) reactions are rare due to

options.content: increase in entropy and activation energy as more molecules are involved
shifting of equilibrium towards reactants due to elastic collisions
loss of active species on collision
low probability of simultaneous collision of all the reacting species
